decisions.reason: This lever handle family sits at the core of the firm's ergonomic design and fittings know-how, so it can readily interpret market feedback and refine the models, and it survived the 2019 pruning that removed sibling lines A and E.

This single handle design builds directly on established competencies and remained listed in 2019 while D was withdrawn, but as a single design rather than a family it is somewhat more exposed to routine portfolio rationalisation.

This flagship electronic access system with its unique light technology anchors the firm's strategic move into digital building organisation, and in-house R&D and patented engineering give it the absorptive capacity to keep developing it.
